children: Binance said withdrawals are now re-enabled for SOL, covering SOL, USDT and USDC, bringing the total number of networks reopened to ten, according to its latest update on X.

The other enabled networks are BTC (BTC); ETH (ETH, USDT, USDC); BSC (BNB, USDT, USDC); XRP (XRP); Base (ETH, USDC); DOGE (DOGE); OP, or Optimism (ETH, USDT, USDC); Arbitrum (ARB, ETH, USDT, USDC); and TRX (TRX, USDT).
The exchange said it will continue to restore additional assets and networks in phases as security checks are completed, with further updates through official Binance channels.

title: Binance Adds SOL Withdrawals, Bringing Re-Enabled Networks to Ten
